flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/mha/{upload/jobs/MhaNricUploadJob,upload/helpers/MhaNricDataHelper,download/jobs/MhaNricDownloadJob,download/helpers/MhaNricDownloadHelper}, framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService, framework/schedulers/{MhaDownloadJobsScheduler,ToppanUploadJobsScheduler}, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository, notification_sms_email (opt-out prerequisite), cron-schedules-prod.properties. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminui, thirdpartyapi: not used
note: Status in stories.json: 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: 'Vault Code Split. Vault needs to run as the notice needs to get vehicle and owner info' (Vault permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code follows the story text. The particulars check and update (Epic OCMS8) is in the MHA upload/download jobs (NRIC holders, id_type N) and the DataHive UEN/FIN job (id_type F and B). The selection queries include stage RD2 and do not distinguish roles, so a hirer who is the current offender is checked. The update only touches the current offender row (OCMS-DF-2026-177, Closed). Gaps: (1) the DataHive UEN/FIN job is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false); (2) no gate makes the 2nd letter wait for the MHA result, the order only comes from the cron schedule; (3) the story condition that the electronic reminder was sent or the hirer opted out is not a condition in the MHA query, and the eNotification cron itself is off in prod; (4) letter generation by the 00:15 cron is off, manual trigger only; (5) the file exchange with MHA, the result file content, Vault and SFTP permission cannot verify from repo. Same fits as OCMS12.6 (owner version), with an extra prerequisite step. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-177 (offender indicator, Closed), OCMS-DF-2026-133 (remark: the MHA cron was not yet switched on in PRD at that time; conflicts with enabled=true in the properties, the real value cannot verify), OCMS-DF-2026-176 (owner_driver timestamp, Ready to UAT).
recommendation: Claim partially. The MHA selector and the offender particulars update exist and are enabled in the prod properties; the DataHive FIN/UEN path is off in prod, the reminder/opt-out prerequisite is not chained, and no gate holds the 2nd letter until the MHA result arrives. Ask for evidence that the MHA cron is active in PRD and a URA decision on the gate.

steps.step: The particulars check runs after the electronic reminder was sent or the hirer was checked as opted out
steps.detail: The two prerequisites exist but separately: opt-out is checked in the eNotification job (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-231; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1134) and the electronic reminder is sent by the same job. The MHA query findNoticesForMhaNricUpload (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:556-581, called from MhaNricDataHelper.java:81) reads neither ocms_sms_notification_records nor ocms_email_notification_records nor the exclusion list, so the particulars check does not wait for the reminder to be sent or for the opt-out; the order comes only from the cron schedule (MHA upload runs Mon-Sat at 09:00, 14:00, 21:00 and is enabled in prod, cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106). The eNotification cron itself is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236). Sebagian: both prerequisites exist in code but are not chained as a condition.

steps.step: Hirer notices about to go to the 2nd letter (stage RD2) are selected for a particulars check with MHA (NRIC holders)
steps.detail: findNoticesForMhaNricUpload selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= tomorrow, suspension_type IS NULL, id_type N, offender_indicator Y, not yet in ocms_nro_temp and the ID not in ocms_hst (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:556-581). There is no role filter, so a hirer who is the current offender is included. The helper calls that query (MhaNricDataHelper.java:77-81) and MhaNricUploadJob builds the enquiry file from the result (MhaNricUploadJob.java:156). So a hirer with an NRIC at stage RD1 whose next stage is RD2 and who is due is sent to MHA. The mhaupload cron is enabled=true in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:105-106). FIN or company hirers do not go through this path (see step 4).

steps.step: The latest particulars of an NRIC-holder hirer are received from MHA and updated (name, life status, birth/death date, address)
steps.detail: MhaNricDownloadJob reads the result file (processResponseFile, MhaNricDownloadJob.java:556) and then applyStatusUpdates (MhaNricDownloadJob.java:633; MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:484). Name, lifeStatus, dateOfBirth, dateOfDeath and the mha_reg address are updated only for rows with offender_indicator Y; when the ID is no longer the offender, the record is skipped and becomes an error row in the report (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:772-790, 835-867; OCMS-DF-2026-177 Closed, Prod deployed). The download job is enabled=true in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:119-120). Sebagian because the NRO file exchange with MHA over SFTP and the content of the result file cannot verify from repo; the remark of ticket OCMS-DF-2026-133 says the MHA cron was not yet switched on in PRD at that time while the properties say enabled=true, the real value cannot verify from repo; OCMS-DF-2026-176 (owner_driver timestamps not updated) is still Ready to UAT.

steps.step: The particulars of FIN-holder and company (UEN) hirers are checked and updated through DataHive
steps.detail: DataHiveUenFinService selects notices with next_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type IS NULL, id_type IN (F, B), offender_indicator Y and not in ocms_nro_temp or ocms_hst (DataHiveUenFinService.java:235-246), so FIN or company hirers at RD2 are included. But MhaDownloadJobsScheduler skips this second job when cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:43-44, 103-106) and the value is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52, comment: wait until the DataHive view name is verified). In the prod configuration FIN and company hirers are not checked. The content of the DataHive view (DOS) cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: After the checks the notice is ready for the 2nd letter; notices suspended by the check result are not processed
steps.detail: The Toppan letter query for stage RD2 only takes notices with suspension_type IS NULL (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:608-613), so a notice given TS-NRO or PS by the MHA result is not processed (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:1119-1125 for TS-NRO). But no gate in the code makes the 2nd letter wait for the MHA result: the Toppan query does not look at ocms_nro_temp, the order only comes from the cron schedule (MHA upload 09:00/14:00/21:00, download 11:30/16:30/23:30, cron-schedules-prod.properties:105, 119), so a late MHA result does not hold the letter. Also letter generation by the 00:15 cron is switched off (ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118 is commented out; cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62 only runs the other day-end jobs) and letters only run through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34). Creating the 2nd letter itself is rated in OCMS12.26.
